name: axHub sync (one look, settings and data for every app and device)
description: Keeps an app's whole setup on axHub so every app and every device (web, Android, others) matches: the shared look document (colour + style theme, layout, menus, spacing, hidden chrome; appearance@1), the app's Settings screen values (hub-settings@1, lib-hubstore) and, if chosen, its data tables (hub-table@1). Look 'required' waits for the hub like a developer app; 'follow' uses the same look but still opens while the hub is down. Ships Settings → Plugins → axHub sync: connect (address, project, test, sign in), what syncs, status. The connection is the only thing kept on the device. Built Oct 24 2026.

params.label: axHub address
params.help: https only (http only for localhost while developing).

params.label: Hub project
params.help: Folder on the hub. Apps on the same project share one look.

params.label: Look
params.help: required = wait for axHub; follow = match axHub but open without it; off = own look.

params.label: Settings on axHub
params.help: The Settings screen's values, the same on every device (secrets never).

params.label: App data
params.help: off = on the device; all = every table on axHub; some = the tables below.
